tool.name: microsoft_learn_search
tool.description: Searches and retrieves official Microsoft Learn documentation, technical articles, code samples, and tutorials. Use this tool whenever the user asks a question about any Microsoft technology, product, service, API, SDK, or development pattern. Returns structured content including article text, titles, and canonical URLs.

invoke_when: User asks how to configure, set up, or use any Microsoft product or service
User asks what a Microsoft technology is or how it works
User asks for code examples related to any Microsoft SDK or API
User asks for best practices related to Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, or related services
User asks a follow-up question that requires additional Microsoft documentation
do_not_invoke_when: The user's question is purely conversational or asks for a previous answer to be rephrased
The retrieved content from the current session already covers the user's follow-up question

session_management.note: Persist the MCP session ID across conversation turns. Pass it on every subsequent tool call to maintain server-side context and avoid re-initialisation overhead on each turn.

deduplication.note: Before passing results to the agent for rendering, normalise all returned URLs (strip trailing slashes, lowercase scheme and host, remove tracking parameters: wt.mc_id, WT.mc_id, ocid, WT.srch, utm_*). Suppress any result whose normalised URL already appeared in a prior turn of this session.

source_rendering.note: Sources must NEVER be rendered as a visible list, raw URL block, or Sources section. The most relevant retrieved URL surfaces exclusively as the final line of the agent response in the format: [See more: Article Title](canonical_url). Only one closing line per turn. If no valid URL was retrieved, the closing line is omitted.
